content.title: VERSION CONTROL, CI/CD & ENVIRONMENT LIFECYCLE
content.content:
- **Native pipeline versioning**: Every pipeline stores its complete version history. Developers can compare versions, restore to any previous version, and view the commit history for pipeline artefacts.

- **Git integration (GitLab, GitHub, Bitbucket)**: SnapLogic integrates directly with Git as the external system of record for pipeline artefacts. Developers commit their work (via the Designer's built-in Git UI and webhook schemas; commit). Pipeline artefacts (.slpkg packages) are committed to GitLab repositories via the SnapLogic Migration REST API and webhook integration — enabling CI/CD promotion workflows from Dev → Test → Prod using Airbus Helicopters' existing Ground Plex instances.

- **Multi-stage development lifecycle**: Separate Ground Plex instances for Development, Test, and Production. Each environment has independent credentials, schedules, and RBAC controls. Pipeline packages are promoted between environments via the `.slpkg` format — RBAC controls prevent developers from promoting directly to Production without passing through the defined CI/CD promotion workflow.

- **Environment-level configuration separation**: Dev, Test, and Production Ground Plex instances are isolated at the infrastructure level. No shared credentials or accounts with across environments. Separate OpenShift namespaces are recommended for full network-level isolation.

- **Autonomous platform configuration**: Full REST API for Org management, user provisioning, ACL configuration, and Ground Plex management — enabling Infrastructure-as-Code patterns for the SnapLogic environment itself (Ansible, Terraform, GitLab CI).
